sources.title: PostgreSQL 16.16 Documentation (A4)
sources.retrieval_instructions: Download A4 PDF for PostgreSQL 16 from https://www.postgresql.org/docs/ to data/local/raw/postgresql-16-A4.pdf. The URL is mutable: require SHA-256 4cf9a4f56001191572e07959396120de0d61ca65d29072df66f9e656c24ae568 and cover/metadata version 16.16; stop if bytes differ and obtain matching snapshot, do not silently replace corpus. Extract using pypdf 6.21.4 and normalization nfc-whitespace-paragraphs-v1: python starter/scripts/extract_corpus.py. Preserve physical pages and original notice at physical page 2; copy p0002.txt to NOTICE.txt alongside normalized pages. Selected physical pages 97-132 and 148-151 only (40 pages). See data/README.md and data/rights/postgresql-16.16.md. No full-text excerpts or original PDF are submitted to Git.
